    The left almost-split boundary of an injective module #

    For an indecomposable injective finite right module I, the canonical map I → I / soc(I) is left almost split and left minimal. The factorization argument uses essentiality of the simple socle: any map out of I which does not split as a monomorphism must kill the socle and hence descend through the quotient.
